v: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet
and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”
So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around Him.
And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.
When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.
For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”
His disciples answered, “You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’”
But He kept looking around to see who had done this.
Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.
“Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”
While He was still speaking, messengers from the house of Jairus arrived and said, “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?”
But Jesus overheard their conversation and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”
And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
When they arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.
He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.”

And they laughed at Him.
After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in to see the child.
Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koum!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”
Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). And at once they were utterly astounded.
Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.

paras: After Jesus cast the demons out, He and His closest followers went back to the other side of the lake, and there was a large crowd waiting for them there.
And a man named Jairus ran up to Jesus and said, "Jesus, my daughter is dying, please come and heal her." So, Jesus went with him to his house, and the large crowd also went along with them.
In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for 12 years. She had seen lots of doctors and spent all of her money. But, in the end she only got worse.

The woman thought, "If I could just touch his clothes, I know I'll be healed." So, she worked her way through the crowd and came up behind Jesus and reached out and touched His robe. All of sudden, the bleeding stopped and she could feel that she was all better.
Well, Jesus felt that power had gone out of Him, and He immediately stopped and turned around and said, "Who touched me?"
One of Jesus' closest followers said to Him, "What do you mean 'who touched you'? There is a huge crowd pressing all around you." But Jesus kept looking around to see who touched Him.
Finally, the woman came forward, and she was so afraid that she was literally shaking, and she fell on her knees in front of Jesus and told Him everything that happened and how she had been healed.
And Jesus said to the woman, "Daughter, your faith has made you well. You're not going to suffer from this anymore."
At the same time, someone from Jairus's house came and said to the man, "Don't bother Jesus anymore. Your daughter has died."
But Jesus looked at Jairus and said, "Don't be afraid. Just believe". So, they continued to the house.
When they got to the house, they saw a huge crowd had gathered and were crying over the girl's death.

Then Jesus took Jairus and his wife, and three of His closest followers and went into the room where the girl's body was. Then He took the girl's hand and said to her, "Little girl, get up". And immediately she got up. And everyone was amazed.
